setup.shell: python3 -c "import json,subprocess,os;d=json.loads(subprocess.run(['python3','qa/drive.py','--port',os.environ['PORT'],'--display',os.environ['DISPLAY'],'view3d'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout);h=d['rect'][3];print('viewport height',h);raise SystemExit(0 if h>=540 else 1)"

items.check: Full editor with red boxes around the left toolbar, the Foliage palette and the bottom strip.
The left toolbar with Foliage (5) highlighted, then the whole Foliage palette panel at 2x.
A terrain carrying many Scatter Items: Grass/Tree/Pine/Bush/Rock/Flowers/Pebbles/+Bush/+Flowers/+Pine at 2x.
The Foliage strip at 2x: Size, Density, Slope Min/Max, Erase All, Fill Terrain, Clear.
The sandbox hill with props sitting on the terraced slope, hint bar at the bottom.
Clicking Foliage (slot 5) in the left toolbar opens the right palette and the bottom strip.
LMB-dragging with +Pine selected paints a band of +Pine.
LMB-dragging with +Bush selected paints a band of +Bush.
LMB-dragging with +Flowers selected paints a colourful band of flowers.
items.notes: Density raised to ~0.85 so the blooms read at this framing.

items.check: LMB-dragging with Rock selected paints a band of Rock.
Grass selected: RMB erases a patch of blades, then LMB paints a patch back.
Same framing: grass tufts present, then erased (the ground stays green).
A band of pines is painted, then RMB erasing carves a gap through the selected kind only.
Erase All ticked: RMB removes every prop under the brush, hint bar says erase every prop.
Pine selected: Fill Terrain scatters pines over the whole terrain by their own rules.
Clear removes every instance of the selected prop from the terrain.
Inspector Look > Grass at 2x: Turf Stuff, Grass Pixel Size, Grass Outline, Ledge Cutoff, Min Height.
Settings > Grass page strip at 2x: Grass, Animation FPS, Subdivisions, Grass Size, Ledge Cutoff, Min Height.
Toggling the Settings > Grass checkbox: all grass blade tufts vanish, then return.
Grass blades on vs off, same framing; the ground colour does not change.
Same pine dab at Density 0.05 / 0.20 / 0.50 / 0.81 / 1.0: sparse to almost touching.
items.notes: Density is an HSlider; the harness drag overshoots, so the thumb is set by a 2-px drag at the fraction position.

items.check: One pine stroke at Size 2.5 / 15 / 30.5 / 52: the painted footprint grows.
items.notes: Size is an HSlider (1-50); set through the thumb fraction (value = 1 + 49*frac).

items.check: Shift+wheel grows the brush (Size value in the strip updates) then paints a wider stroke.
items.notes: Records viewport + strip; the rect stops above the bottom-panel tab/status row (the verified run used 735 px; this trims the last 15 px of chrome).

items.check: Grass blades at Grass Pixel Size 1 / 2 / 4 / 8: progressively chunkier blocks.
items.notes: Grass Pixel Size is set with set-prop grass_pixel_size --class MarchingSquaresTerrain (the Inspector spin rows have no stable names).

items.check: PixelScatterItem Inspector at 2x: Display Name, Form, Shape Seed, Cage, Scene, Tint, group list.
Expanded Placement group at 2x: Density, Scale Min/Max, Random Yaw, Align to Normal, Texture1-16 flags.
Settings > LOD & Nature strip at 2x: LOD Distance, Erosion Add, LOD In Editor, Wild Flowers Add.
MarchingSquaresWildFlowers Inspector at 2x: Terrain, Scatter/Clear buttons, Species, Seed, Placement, Ground water.
Wild Flowers strip Placement tab at 2x: Scatter, Clear, Seed, Density, Patch Scale, Threshold, Max Slope, Points/Cell, Jitter.
Wild Flowers strip Ground Water tab at 2x: Ground Water, Variation, Shore Wet, Water Level, Shore Dist., Trees Shade.
Pressing Scatter blooms a wild-flower meadow, clustered toward the pond shore.
Pressing Clear removes the wild flowers again.
Painting a + entry: the first stroke adds the real item, palette label '+ Bush' becomes 'Bush'.
Paint a rock cluster, then Ctrl+Z removes it in one undo step.
Rocks painted along the pond shoreline, like a pebble beach at the waterline.
items.notes: Rocks are kept at the waterline with Slope Max 20; three passes along the shore. The crop ends at the viewport bottom (the verified run used 540 px from the same top, which included the strip).

items.check: A dense flower meadow painted back and forth over flat grass.
A dense pine band whose margin thins into open grass: a natural tree line.
